$comment: Motion tokens (T016, + `animation` group T516). Tailwind's duration-<n> utility already takes a bare millisecond number, so these durations are the closed set a component picks from (duration-120, not duration-137) rather than a Tailwind theme namespace. Easings map onto Tailwind's ease-* namespace. The `animation` group names the loops the system actually runs, `spin` and `pulse`, each composing a `duration` and an `easing` key from this same file (not a literal) plus an `iterationCount` and a `keyframes` map; `build-tokens.mjs` emits `@keyframes ds-<name>` and `--animate-<name>` from each entry (contracts/token-families.md §1). Both loops are gated behind Tailwind's `motion-safe:` variant at every call site, so under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the animation utility does not apply at all and the element sits at its resting frame (FR-055) — `motion-safe:animate-spin` / `motion-safe:animate-pulse` replace today's arbitrary `animate-[...]` bracket syntax without changing that behaviour. Edit here, then run `pnpm --filter design-system tokens:build`.
